description: Search fan conventions (furry, anime, gaming) across 51 US and Canadian metro areas. Returns upcoming conventions by default (soonest first); set include_past to search the archive too. Filter by text, community, region, state, metro, or date range. Returns dates, venue, location, registration windows and table costs, plus a canonical ArtistAlly URL per convention.

community.description: Filter by community: furry, anime, gaming, or multi (multi-genre).

include_past.description: Include conventions that have already finished (default false). Past results are still sorted soonest-first; use starts_after/starts_before to target a specific year.

query.description: Free-text match on convention name, venue, or city, e.g. "Otafest" or "Atlanta".

region.description: Coverage region, e.g. "Southeast", "Midwest", "West Coast", "Canada". Valid values come from artistally_get_coverage.

starts_after.description: Only conventions starting on or after this date (YYYY-MM-DD).

starts_before.description: Only conventions starting on or before this date (YYYY-MM-DD).

state.description: Two-letter US state or Canadian province code, e.g. "GA", "TX", "ON".

name: artistally_search_conventions
title: Search conventions
